_approach: The hyperpop side of the fusion (per EDMProd and Aesthetics Wiki, krushclub takes its 'pitched-up vocal styles' and maximalist production from hyperpop): a trap/hyperpop-style hi-hat roll accelerates from straight 16ths into a dense burst before every backbeat hit, mimicking the vocal-chop stutter hyperpop producers apply. The 5-kick Jersey pattern stays underneath, but the hats are the loudest decoration in the mix, capped just under the ≥90 accent threshold so the kick and clap stack stay the skeleton. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
